narrationTexts: I'll look at the history and changelog.
finalText:
**Wrote the 4.2.0 draft into [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md:3).** Out of 380 commits, 14 real changes.

Expired tokens now return `401`, not `403`. Webhook retries with backoff are new. Request bodies no longer hit the log.

Three calls for you:

| item | question |
|---|---|
| perf work | Four speedups landed. No heading fits them. |
| Node version | Five docs commits touch it. No `engines` change found. |
| v1 export route | Commit says unused. Confirm it was never public. |
